Author: mdmanurung
Message:
analysis(benchmark): fair-comparison 2x2 harmonization + GTF artifact root cause (PR-T5b)

Fixes three confounds in the STARsolo-vs-ViralScan benchmark (12/12 rows complete):

1. DENOMINATOR: shared anchor = intersection of STARsolo filtered cells ∩ ViralScan
   per_cell barcodes, computed per dataset (3517/1908/3307 cells).
2. COUNT LAYER: STARsolo unique-integer vs ViralScan counts_original (not multimap-corrected).
3. TARGET MATCHING: HSV-1 regex now includes hhv-?1 + nc_001806 (stale regex → STAR=0).

HSV-1 root cause is a DUAL GTF ARTIFACT (not aligner sensitivity):
  (A) 61/79 HHV1 genes in combined STAR GTF have CDS-only records (no exon) →
      zero-counted by STARsolo GeneFull. Same mechanism as anellovirus F-005 (7739521).
  (B) The 18 exon-bearing genes cluster in HSV-1 terminal repeats with 11 overlapping
      pairs; 27.4% of exon bases are ambiguous → only 2 genes get any UMI at all
      (HHV1gp00p13: 27, HHV1gp00p03: 3). Total = 30 UMI / 19 on anchor.
  Clean comparison requires fixing the combined GTF exon records — NOT possible without
  rebuilding the STAR index.

Clean findings (HHV6B + EBV):
  - Aligner axis (unique layer): VS/STAR = 1.9× (HHV6B) and 1.96×/1.81× (EBV combined/two_step)
  - Reference strategy: minor for all three viruses (combined ≈ two_step)

Added files:
  analysis/reference_strategy_benchmark/scripts/harmonize_2x2.py  (reproducible script)
  analysis/reference_strategy_benchmark/scripts/run.sh             (entrypoint)
  analysis/reference_strategy_benchmark/scripts/register_report_values.py  (35 values → numbers.json)
  analysis/reference_strategy_benchmark/outputs/harmonized_2x2_unique.tsv
  analysis/reference_strategy_benchmark/outputs/hsv1_root_cause.json
  analysis/reference_strategy_benchmark/outputs/feature_match_audit.tsv
  analysis/reference_strategy_benchmark/outputs/numbers.json

Updated:
  .living/findings/reference_strategy_2x2.md   (full finding with all tables + GTF diagnosis)
  PLAN.md: PR-T5b corrected (dual GTF artifact, not aligner sensitivity; .living ref resolved)
  src/viralscan/reference_strategy.py: HSV-1 regex + off-target regex extended with hhv-?1/2

scilintr: 0 findings (analysis/reference_strategy_benchmark/scripts/)
Closes PLAN PR-T5b.

  60+ safe auto-fixes + `ruff format` (60 files). Cosmetic UP007/UP045/SIM117
  ignored with rationale; substantive findings fixed (SIM115 file-handle leaks in
  evidence_run, B017 broad-raises). `ruff check .` clean.
- RR4.3: drop mypy `ignore_errors=true` for the 7 Snakemake scripts + research
  reference_strategy; type-check them for real errors (annotation-completeness codes
  relaxed). Fixed 11 latent findings: None-narrowing asserts documenting the Snakefile
  invariants (host_index/host_h5ad), stale `# type: ignore` removals, a loop-var
  type clash in analysis.py, implicit-Optional seeds default. `mypy -p viralscan`
  clean (29 files).
